distinctness_review_dependencies.reason: All 120 current site names/keys and Australian locators were screened. None is NEXTDC M2, M3, S3 or S4. M3 at West Footscray is separate from CDC Brooklyn; S3 at 2 Broadcast Way is separate from Goodman SYD01 in Artarmon; S4 at 16 Johnston Crescent is separate from CDC Eastern Creek. The four source addresses are mutually distinct campuses, and multiple remaining data halls at each campus count only once. S6 is excluded from this batch pending adjacent-campus review.
